st: Population growth trends and approaches to relationships (= sex).

sec.p: The exponential growth of the last century, in every field, is really hard to digest. In the chart below, the number of people in the world. An increase linked above all to lower infant mortality.

One of the most populous countries in the world still in the middle of the transition is Nigeria. As you can see below, the average number of children per woman stands at 5.25, far from Italy's 1.30 or France's 1.84.
As I said, sociological and cultural factors are behind this slowdown in growth. In the near future we'll talk more directly about sex and relationships; for now, a few teasers.
Single? No problem. There's a chart for you too!
